competitiveTarget: Long-tail SEO: 'homes for sale in {zip}'. ZIPs carry no cached market row, so the snapshot + subdivision grid are derived live from listing_tile_mv tiles (CLAUDE.md §0) — a real ZIP market page, not a bare listings dump.
note: Wave 3 site-v2 rebuild, full mockup fidelity 2026-06-02. ONE getZipListings(zip, {propertyType:'A', limit:250}) call feeds the hero lede (active count, median list, median DOM), the ZipMarketStats snapshot (active SFR, median list, median $/sqft, new-30d — all derived from the tiles), the subdivision RelatedAreas grid (grouped from the same tiles), and the ListingCard grid. A second RelatedAreas renders the other canonical ZIPs (static service-area labels). CtaDuo replaces the prior single CTABar. NO getMarketPulse/getMarketStats — there are no ZIP-keyed rows, so nothing is fabricated; values that can't be derived render as an em-dash. SiteHeader/SiteFooter render from app/layout.tsx. Canonical 10 ZIPs, dynamicParams=false.
